card.name: Capital S starting a new word
card.fires_on: A bare capital or lowercase S that begins a word split off from the rest, such as the S of Sodium, Sulfate, Suspend, Slight or syringes. It shows up in drug labels, especially after a step number, a sentence end, or inside an all-caps drug name.

modes.label: Salt names in caps
modes.description: S that opens SODIUM or SULFATE after a drug name written in capitals.

modes.label: Sentence or step start
modes.description: S that opens the first word of a new step or sentence, such as Suspend or Slight.

modes.label: Inside a list
modes.description: Lowercase s opening syringes in a parenthesized list of equipment.

card.writes: It suppresses odd foreign-language tokens and mildly promotes the word solution, so it has little clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires when a lone S begins a word like sodium, sulfate, suspend or syringes in a drug label.
